snippet.title: Virtual Pool 2 Demo (Celeris, 1997)
snippet.description:
#pool #demo #retrogaming
The successor to Virtual Pool, Virtual Pool 2 has better graphics, an enhanced physics engine, and more game options than its predecessor. The game also features photo realistic tables, balls, and environments.
